caveats: Identity boundary: Source-reported employment and online persona in a reused account network; Huy Diep, HuiGia Diep, accounts, biography, and imagery are not a verified civil identity and must not be merged with apparent identity owners.
Nisos reports this as a presented persona within a reused account/infrastructure network; shared handles or numeric tokens do not establish that this label and other labels are one natural person.
This record describes a reported employment persona/account cluster, not proof that the apparent identity owner is a DPRK national.

The cited source page at https://6068438.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/6068438/dprk-github-employment-fraud.pdf carries an image related to this record. It is not reproduced: citation only, no caching, cropping, biometric use, or facial comparison.
Source-reported alias labels with no platform stated: Passion118. They are not shown as account handles; any live account using these strings is not attributed by the source.
Persona names shown here are labels reported by the cited publisher. They are not asserted to be anyone's legal name, and unrelated real people who share a name are not implicated.
'Huy Diep' is a common Vietnamese name; no real person of this name is identified or implicated. This record concerns only the persona tied to nickdev0118 and superbluestar as reported by Nisos.
Accounts and handles are historical observations reported by the cited sources. Present control of any account is not asserted, and a persona name is not asserted to be anyone's legal identity.
